sanskrit_verse:
देशकालवयोद्रव्यसंज्ञाजातिप्रमाणतः ।
अन्यूनं चेन् निगदितं सिद्धं साध्यं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
transliteration: deśakālavayodravyasaṃjñājātipramāṇataḥ | anyūnaṃ cen nigaditaṃ siddhaṃ sādhyaṃ vinirdiśet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When declaration is made concerning land, time, age, wealth, designation, species, or measure, and it is not less than what is required, then that which is declared accomplished shall be established as proven.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in precise contextual specification
Causation is validated through complete descriptive alignment
Capacity-based responsibility requires full declarative adequacy
Restoration logic depends on unambiguous ontological identification
Consciousness alignment occurs when descriptive completeness is achieved
executable_legal_axioms: IF a claim references deśa-kāla-vaya-dravya-saṃjñā-jāti-pramāṇa AND the content is not anyūna THEN the assertion is to be accepted as siddha-sādhya
WHEN descriptive parameters match experiential reality without deficiency THEN recognition of validity is mandatory
IF designation aligns fully with perceptual and categorical accuracy THEN adjudication concludes automatically in favor of alignment
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, declarations grounded in comprehensive context—spanning place, time, identity, category, and measurement—are to be upheld when no deficiency exists in their formulation. The threshold of responsibility lies in ensuring completeness of representation rather than external verification alone.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality affirms that accurate designation leads to rightful establishment. Sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) ensures alignment between cognition and reality. Proportional responsibility arises from clarity of expression. There is no punitive element; correctness itself establishes harmony.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: Ensure all contextual descriptors are fully articulated
Responsibility assumption protocol: Affirm alignment between word and experience
Capacity restoration: Realign speaker's capacity to designate accurately
Integrity reintegration: Reinforce coherence between cognition, speech, and reality
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Justice flows not through punishment but through restoration of correct designation. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
